audit.why: Poppy 51.92% over 495 games; EVEN 6/10 holds. Poppy owns levels 2-3 through the wall stun, everything after flattens into a wave/map lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 gave Shen the stage while their own whys say the opposite — whys[1] and whys[2] describe Poppy's cleanest early punish, whys[5] says 'the raw trade is a wash', whys[6] says 'leaving it even'. All four also disagreed with the packet chart.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill and matches the written reasoning exactly.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Poppy, rows 5 and 6 to Skill, both layers, one group; ratings raised on the two Poppy rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shen's sustain was described as healing off Twilight Assault. Shen has no heal in his kit — Ki Barrier is a shield gained after casting a spell, and Stand United shields too. Shadow Dash's real numbers (600 range, 18/16/14/12/10s) never appeared.
audit.why: The distinction matters mechanically: a shield can be burst through or forced out before you commit, and it stacks nothing against your Q's max-health damage the way a heal would race it.
audit.corrected: Ki Barrier named as a shield you force out before committing (the missing-interaction flag), Spirit's Refuge named as the auto-attack block, and Shadow Dash given its range and cooldown. Steadfast Presence and Hammer Shock's grounding both stop Shadow Dash — that part of the page was already right.

audit.why: Shadow Dash at 18s rank 1 is the punishable window and the page already builds around it; Spirit's Refuge at 16s is the second.

edits.before: Dash taunt — your W can disable it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shadow Dash taunts, 18s at rank 1 — W stops it and grounds him where he lands.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — Dash taunt — your W can disable it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — a 600-range taunt dash, 18s at rank 1; W stops it and grounds him. Track it before every engage. - Your E: never spend it without a wall. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): Dash taunt — your W can disable it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Track Shadow Dash: a 600-range taunt dash, 18s at rank 1 — W stops it. In that window — E-Q + R him.

edits.before: Q+E come online: E into the wall stuns him and Q chunks his max HP before his sustain can answer it.
edits.after: Q+E come online: E into the wall stuns him and Q chunks his max HP straight through Ki Barrier.

edits.before: His empowered-Q sustain heals your flat poke and W can block your follow-up autos, so trades equalize.
edits.after: Ki Barrier shields off your flat poke and Spirit's Refuge blocks your follow-up autos, so trades equalize.

edits.before: Q+E online — E him into the wall behind the melee creeps for a free stun and Q max-HP chunk before his sustain matters.
edits.after: Q+E online — E him into the wall behind the melee creeps for a free stun, then Q his max HP before Ki Barrier shields it.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 flatten out because his empowered Q (Twilight Assault) sustain and your flat damage both scale poorly with points. You out-trade him in any wall-stun all-in, but he heals your poke back, so pick your spots when his W is cooling. At 6 his ult is a map tool, not a lane spike — when you see him channel his global R to save an ally, shove hard and look to take plates or roam, because he's effectively spending his teamfight presence elsewhere.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 flatten out because Twilight Assault and your flat damage both scale poorly with points. You out-trade him in any wall-stun all-in, but Ki Barrier shields the poke back off, so take your spots while Spirit's Refuge is cooling. At 6 his ult is a map tool, not a lane spike — when you see him channel Stand United to save an ally, shove hard and take plates or roam, because he's spending his teamfight presence elsewhere.

edits.before: Use his passive empowered Q (Twilight Assault) to out-sustain your flat poke and shove for plates
edits.after: Chain spells so Ki Barrier's shield keeps eating your flat poke while he shoves for plates

edits.before: Punish him whenever his W (auto-block) is on cooldown — that's when your Q+AA trade actually lands
edits.after: Trade while Spirit's Refuge is on its 16s cooldown — that is when your Q plus autos actually land

notes: Shen has no heal anywhere in his kit; the page called Ki Barrier sustain/healing in four places. Corrected to a shield, which is also the flagged missing interaction — force it out before committing. Steadfast Presence stopping Shadow Dash was already stated correctly and is left alone. Level chart had four rows contradicting both the packet and their own whys; flipped in matched pairs.
